questions.solution_md:
Katetlarni $a$ va $b$ deb belgilaymiz. To'g'ri burchakli uchburchakda ichki chizilgan aylana radiusi $r=\dfrac{a+b-c}{2}$, bundan $a+b=c+2r=17+6=23$.

Yarim perimetr: $p=\dfrac{a+b+c}{2}=\dfrac{23+17}{2}=20$.

Yuza: $S=pr=20\cdot 3=60$ sm².

Площадь: $S=pr=35\cdot 6=210$ см².

en.solution_md:

Area: $S=pr=30\cdot 4=120$ cm².

ru.solution_md:

Area: $S=pr=35\cdot 6=210$ cm².

kaa.stem_md: Tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshliktiń katetleri $16$ hám $30$. Ishki hám sırtqı sızılǵan sheńberler radiusları qosındısın tabıń.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlikte $R=\frac{c}{2}$ (gipotenuza — diametr) hám $r=\frac{a+b-c}{2}$ formulaların shatastırıw.

en.mistake_note_md: Mixing up $R=\frac{c}{2}$ (hypotenuse is a diameter) and $r=\frac{a+b-c}{2}$.
